settings.title: Diagnostics
settings.subtitle: How HousePulse sees your energy devices. Copy the report and include it when you report a problem.
settings.copyManually: The text is selected. Copy it with your device's copy function.
settings.waitText: After a restart Homey starts all apps at the same time. Tick the apps that own your energy devices (inverter, meter, charger…): HousePulse waits until they run, so it never starts from missing or old values. At most 10 minutes, then it starts anyway.
settings.waitSaved: Saved. Applies from the next start.
settings.lastNoWait: Last start: did not wait for any apps.
settings.lastWaited: Last start: waited {s} s for the apps.
settings.lastTimedOut: Last start: started anyway after {s} s. Not running: {apps}.
settings.moreEnergy: Show more apps with energy devices ({n})
